## Deck Goal
Teach Year-2 physics students to treat a parameter sweep as a controlled computational experiment: vary one named parameter, hold the model and other inputs fixed, evaluate the same model for every case, overlay labelled curves on common axes, validate a known or limiting case, diagnose a runnable but physically wrong calculation, and explain the trend.
